description: Find who supplies a food, beverage, dietary-supplement or pet-food ingredient: manufacturers, distributors and traders from the SKS Ingredient Index (about 265 ingredients, 790 suppliers worldwide, compiled from public sources). Use it whenever the user asks who makes, sells, sources or distributes an ingredient, wants supplier or vendor options, or is choosing where to buy a raw material (e.g. 'allulose suppliers', 'Halal collagen manufacturers', 'US-based ashwagandha suppliers', 'who sells MCT oil powder'). Filter by country and by claimed credential (Halal, Kosher, Organic, Non-GMO, GFSI food safety, GMP). Returns supplier name, country, type, website, listed products and claimed credentials, plus the ingredient's FDA GRAS notice count, US private-label retailer status and a link to the full page. Credentials are suppliers' own claims; suppliers are alphabetical, not ranked.

country.description: Optional supplier headquarters country, e.g. 'United States', 'China', 'India', 'Germany'.

ingredient.description: Ingredient name, trade name or form, e.g. 'allulose', 'vitamin D3', 'KSM-66', 'pea protein isolate'.

name: find_ingredient_suppliers
title: Find ingredient suppliers
